mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, USER_NAME, EMAIL, GENDER, AGE, ENROLL_DATE, STATUS FROM MEMBER WHERE USER_ID != 'admin' ORDER BY USER_ID ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET USER_ID = #{userId}, USER_NAME = #{userName}, EMAIL = #{email}, GENDER = #{gender}, AGE = #{age}, ENROLL_DATE = #{enrollDate}, STATUS = #{status}, PHONE = #{phone}, ADDRESS = #{address} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
